claims.text: Defense Intelligence Reference Document titled "Laser Lightcraft Nanosatellites", series "Defense Futures", published 2010-11-01 with an Intelligence Cut-Off Date (ICOD) of 2010-08-30, DIA document number DIA-08-1011-001. Released by DIA under FOIA and posted in the DIA FOIA Electronic Reading Room.

Inside cover reads: "This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2009 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted b(3) 10 USC 424] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program" and directs questions to the "AAWSA Program Manager, Defense Intelligence Agency, ATTN: [redacted], Bldg 6000, Washington, DC 20340-5100".

Author name is withheld in the DIA-released copy under FOIA exemption (b)(6); the "Prepared by:" line is withheld under (b)(3) 10 USC 424. The released cover therefore does not attribute the DIRD to a named author.
Released PDF is 77 pages, marked UNCLASSIFIED//FOR OFFICIAL USE ONLY (FOUO caveat partially illegible in the scan).
Cover page reads: '01 November 2010 / ICOD 30 August 2010 / DIA-08-1011-001 / Defense Intelligence Reference Document / Defense Futures / Laser Lightcraft Nanosatellites'.

Attributed on the DIA list of AATIP/AAWSAP products supplied to the Senate Armed Services Committee to 'Dr E Davis, EarthTech'. The author line on the released PDF is redacted under (b)(5)/(b)(6), so the congressional list is the sole naming authority.

Administrative note on the cover page: 'This product is one in a series of advanced technology reports produced in FY 2010 under the Defense Intelligence Agency [redacted] Advanced Aerospace Weapon System Applications (AAWSA) Program.'
